qualification_scope: Exact aggregate-trace certification plus a predeclared symmetric-Nitsche energy floor c*=1/4 for every accepted current state of the supported production Navier-Stokes viscous/Nitsche subform, whose module supplies the bulk viscous energy K. The generic FE gate is conditional on an installed caller-supplied coercive bulk form and does not independently prove that bulk hypothesis. This matrix does not close FSR-16, FSR-07, WP-3, WP-7, or Q1, and does not prove that every cut or mesh-family state will be accepted.
